blurb: Embark on a culinary adventure through Atlanta’s vibrant Inman Park, where history and flavor intertwine in this guided walking tour. Begin your journey amid the charming Victorian homes of Inman Park, a neighborhood steeped in history and brimming with culinary delights. As you stroll along the Atlanta BeltLine Eastside Trail, your knowledgeable guide will lead you through the heart of the city’s food culture, highlighting both the innovative and the traditional. You'll explore Krog Street Market, a bustling epicenter where local artisans and vendors present their finest creations, from gourmet bites to unique beverages. The journey continues to the Krog Street Tunnel, a dynamic canvas of street art that vividly reflects Atlanta's creative soul.
